candidate_edge_rule: An unordered pair is a candidate when its records share at least one task or at least one stage and neither record declares a relation to the other. A candidate is not a declared relation.
degree_rule: Total degree counts incoming and outgoing declared edge instances; candidate edges do not contribute.
excluded_by_design: Inference of causality or mechanism from a declared relation
A claim that two candidate edges should be merged
Prediction of a relation the catalogue does not declare
isolated_node_rule: A record is isolated when it declares no outgoing relation, even if another record points to it.
provenance_rule: A directed edge is evidenced only by evidence entries in its declaring source record whose supports list names relations. Without such an entry it is unevidenced.
